_doc: arm_reshape.py: rear = points behind y move back by factor k of their distance to y; height = z scale of the whole path (away from the body); front = between y[0] and y[1] the tips move outward by splay and forward by longer (smoothstep); mid = between y[0] and y[1] the front arc is drawn inward by up to inward (sin^2 bump); junction = the turn into the front arc moved aft (sin^2 bump over y); shoulder = upper branch (z above z[0], full at z[1]) raised by up over y; loop_curl = behind y (over `over` m) the loop's lower part (z below z_top, full z_span lower) raised by up; loop_out = loop wider by out over y; tip_down = front tips lowered over y; thick = sections scaled where the strap runs at |x| > x_min, y range, z < z_max (faded over fade in f)
